title: Web Scraping with BeautifulSoup 🕸️
description: Parse HTML, traverse the DOM, extract links, tables, and hidden form fields with BeautifulSoup.

slides.title: When There's No API
slides.content:
# Scraping HTML Pages

Many websites don't offer an API. You must fetch the raw HTML and extract the data yourself. `BeautifulSoup` (from `bs4`) makes this painless.

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

html = requests.get('https://example.com').text
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
```

slides.title: Navigating the Soup
slides.codeSnippet:
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup html = '

Title

Content

' soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') print(soup.h1.text) # Title print(soup.p.text) # Content

quizData.question: What does `soup.title` return?
quizData.explanation: It returns the Tag object; use `.string` or `.text` to get its content.

slides.title: find() and find_all()
slides.content:
# The Core Search Methods

* `find(name, attrs)` – returns the first matching element.
* `find_all(name, attrs)` – returns a list of all matches.

```python
links = soup.find_all('a')
for link in links:
    print(link.get('href'))
```
You can filter by attributes: `soup.find_all('div', class_='content')` (use `class_` because `class` is a Python keyword).

slides.title: Extract All Links
slides.codeSnippet: from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from urllib.parse import urljoin html = 'LinkOther' soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') base = 'https://example.com' for a in soup.find_all('a'): full = urljoin(base, a.get('href')) print(full)

quizData.question: How do you find all elements with class 'vulnerable' using BeautifulSoup?
quizData.explanation: `class_` is the parameter name; `select` is also valid but uses CSS selectors. Both are correct; the answer given is A.

slides.title: Extracting Tables and Lists
slides.content:
# Many vulnerabilities are in tables

```python
table = soup.find('table', id='results')
rows = table.find_all('tr')
for row in rows:
    cols = row.find_all('td')
    if cols:
        print(cols[0].text.strip())
```
Adjust selectors for the specific site.

slides.title: CSS Selectors with `select()`
slides.codeSnippet:
soup.select('div.content > p')   # direct children
soup.select('#main')               # ID
soup.select('.vuln-class')         # class
```
`select()` always returns a list.

quizData.question: What does `soup.select('a[href]')` return?

options.text: All <a> tags that have an href attribute
The href attribute of the first <a>

quizData.explanation: `[attr]` selector matches elements with that attribute.

slides.title: Scraping Login Forms
slides.content:
# Find Hidden CSRF Tokens

Many login forms include a hidden `<input>` with a unique token. You must extract it to submit the form successfully.

```python
form = soup.find('form', id='login')
csrf = form.find('input', {'name': 'csrf_token'})
if csrf:
    token = csrf['value']
```
We'll use this in the next lesson.

slides.title: Pro Tip 💡
slides.content:
## Use `lxml` parser for speed (pip install lxml)

`soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'lxml')` is faster and more lenient. Fall back to `html.parser` if lxml not installed.
